4Q258 10:5.en: I will lean on all the day and know that in his hand justice every living and trustworthiness all the work
4Q258 10:5.notes: The translation follows the visible transcription and morphology, with phrase evidence informing 'all the day,' 'every living,' and 'all the work.' The verb 'lean' (nifal stem) and 'know' (qal stem) are rendered conservatively. The suffixed forms 'his hand' and 'his work' are translated literally, preserving agency. No unsupported connectors or participants are added. Uncertainty in the final punctuation mark is omitted from the translation.

4Q258 10:6.en: And in the opening of distress I will praise and in his salvation I will cry out together. I will not return to a man.
4Q258 10:6.notes: The transcription contains a reconstructed verb form 'הפ[ תח' and a damaged suffix on 'ישועת׳ו'. The final word 'איש ]' is incomplete but sufficiently recoverable.

4Q258 10:7.en: Reward of evil in good I pursue, a man. That to the god of justice, every living thing and he.
4Q258 10:7.notes: The phrase 'of God judgments' is supported by repeated evidence for positions 10-11. The phrase 'every living [thing]' is supported by repeated evidence for positions 12-13. The translation preserves the visible morphology and lexical items, with uncertainty in the exact relationship between clauses.

4Q258 10:8.en: He will repay to the man his deed
4Q258 10:8.notes: The final characters 'ε׃' are untranslatable and omitted. The phrase 'ישלם לאיש גמול' is supported by repeated evidence, suggesting a rendering related to repayment or recompense, but the exact sense is uncertain.

4Q258 12:4.en: and he will take possession in the lot of the holy ones
4Q258 12:4.notes: Uncertainty in the transcription and reconstruction of the text, particularly around the damaged and uncertain words, may affect the accuracy of the translation.

4Q258 13:1.notes: The initial character 'ε' is untranslatable and omitted. The verb 'יכ ]פר' is translated based on its morphology and lexical gloss.

4Q258 13:2.en: For all iniquities and in his justice he will cleanse me from menstruation of man and sin of the son of man
4Q258 13:2.notes: The phrase 'O son of humankind' is a high-confidence repeated phrase, but it does not fit the syntax and semantics of the surrounding text. The translation follows the visible morphology and lexical glosses instead.

4Q258 13:3.en: to praise to God of justice
4Q258 13:3.notes: The phrase 'to Zadok' is a repeated pattern but not supported here. The final characters are untranslatable.
